lead: Two to twelve steps in two to four columns. A CSS counter sets the numbers, so reordering the rows in the backend renumbers them.

steps.title: Each step has a heading
steps.text: It is a level-three heading, so screen reader users can jump straight to any step.

steps.title: Plus one or two sentences of instruction
steps.text: Long enough to explain the step, short enough to fit the whole procedure on one screen.

steps.title: The link is optional
steps.text: If a step continues on its own page, add a link to it.

steps.title: Below 768px the columns collapse
steps.text: The steps form a single column and keep their numbers.
